purpose: Recovered multi-model software-maintainer stack registry. This records where each model family belongs in the full observe-orient-act-verify-learn loop. It is a planning/schema artifact only, not execution authority.

ngram_markov.role: Cheap local syntax/style priors and unusual-edit detection.

linear_tree_mlp_heads.role: Transparent gates, route decisions, confidence/OOD heads, shortcut baselines, and junk/risk rankers.

rnn_lstm_gru_trace.role: Sequential workflow/log/action-trace state tracking and loop/thrash detection.
rnn_lstm_gru_trace.placement: Sidecar trace compressor feeding policy heads, not primary code generator.

state_space_mamba.role: Long repo/log/commit-history compression into compact state for attention-limited planners.
state_space_mamba.placement: Pre-attention compressor. Transformer attention can stay bounded while SSM carries longer context.

gnn_repo_graph.role: Repo/call/import/test/dependency graph reasoning and impact propagation.

encoder_only_retriever.role: Evidence retrieval, source grounding, file/symbol/test matching, and reranking.

encoder_decoder_seq2seq.role: State-to-action, structured repair transforms, bounded argument generation, and controlled text/code transformations.

decoder_only_causal.role: Bounded candidate generation after gates authorize decode.

denoiser_masked_lm.role: Repair malformed, short, leaky, repetitive, or verifier-failed outputs via masked infill/editing.

diffusion_iterative_repair.role: Iterative verifier/reward-guided whole-output or patch refinement.
diffusion_iterative_repair.placement: Repair layer after first-pass structured/candidate output, not first-pass maintainer authority.

autoencoder_compressor.role: Compress repo states/diffs/logs and detect anomalies or style outliers.

energy_reward_model.role: Patch quality, minimality, regression risk, and verifier-backed preference scoring.

gan_adversarial_generator.role: Generate hard negative or plausible-bad examples for judge/ranker robustness.

crf_hmm_sequence_labeler.role: Structured sequence labeling for logs, code regions, and workflow states.

bayesian_calibration.role: Uncertainty, calibration, abstention thresholds, and posterior evidence accounting.

moe_lora_adapters.role: Specialize by language, repo family, task type, or surface without one monolithic model.

rl_bandit_controller.role: Tool/test/action selection under budget after supervised structured policies are stable.

world_model_counterfactual.role: Predict consequences of possible edits/actions before execution.

symbolic_verifiers.role: Exact checks: parser, AST, type checker, linter, tests, static analysis, dependency resolver.
symbolic_verifiers.authority_note: Verifier evidence can support acceptance; learned model confidence alone cannot.

fusion_contract.hard_rule: Learned logits propose; deterministic gates and verifiers authorize.

missing_current_implementation: No implemented GNN repo graph encoder.
No formal cross-model forward-pass fusion module.
No activation/SAE interpretability module, only telemetry contracts.
